title: 第十四章 当众表白！
slug: 分手后觉醒逆天改命系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“哈哈，还凑合吧。”叶凡大笑，“行了成章，接下来我要去参加同学会，你还去不去？”

“草！当然去！我现在无比想见到王岩表情。”

李成章道，他虽不知叶凡凭什么能让陈若彤跟来，但他知道后面一定很精彩。

“那走吧。”

叶凡点头，按下电梯，很快三人来到三楼兰花厅。

兰花厅气氛刚缓下来，一看到叶凡三人，气氛又紧张了。

特别是杨花，一看到李成章就猛地跳起，张牙舞爪冲过来。

“杨花，别冲动！”

“拦住她！”

惊呼传出，三四个男生上前，挡住杨花。

李成章冷冷一笑，理都不理杨花，反看向王岩。

王岩脸色变了，本来他想的最坏结果，是叶凡会带盛宝楼某个高管，或是陈若彤司机来，这样他能确定叶凡确实入职盛宝楼，他会想办法和叶凡缓和关系。

现在倒好，陈若彤亲自来了！

“咳…呵呵，没想到我们工大的同学会，能让陈若彤陈总莅临，这可是我们的荣幸。”

“什么，陈若彤！”

“居然是她！”

众人一惊，作为工大学生，他们当然知道陈若彤。

陈家作为珠宝世家，影响力巨大，在海外都经常举办展览会和拍卖会，资产上百亿，陈若彤作为陈家大小姐，更一度登上省内优秀企业家名单，他们岂会不知？

“呵呵，王少客气，我来这，是单纯陪我盛宝楼的叶凡大师的，要有打扰的地方，还请见谅。”

陈若彤一笑，众人又一惊。

陪叶凡来的？还大师？

叶凡什么时候这么厉害了！

江灵懵了，她想不到，她瞧不上的叶凡，真成了盛宝楼鉴定师！

“呵…呵呵，陈总才是客气。”

王岩干笑一声，看向叶凡，“叶凡，我就知道你会有前途的，现在看果然如此，来，快请坐。”

说着他亲自拉开一把椅子。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Haha, it's okay." Ye Fan laughed, "That's it, I'm going to attend the class reunion next, are you going to go?"

"Fuck! Of course! I really want to see Wang Yan's expression now."

Li Chengzhang said that although he didn't know why Ye Fan asked Chen Ruotong to follow him, he knew that the rest of the show would be exciting.

"Then let's go."

Ye Fan nodded, pressed the elevator, and soon the three of them arrived at the Orchid Hall on the third floor.

The atmosphere in the Orchid Hall had just calmed down, but when they saw Mark and the others, the atmosphere became tense again.

Especially Yang Hua, when she saw Li Chengzhang, she jumped up suddenly and rushed over with her teeth and claws bared.

"Yang Hua, don't be impulsive!"

"Stop her!"

Exclamations came out, and three or four boys stepped forward to block Yang Hua.

Li Chengzhang smiled coldly, ignored Yang Hua, and looked at Wang Yan instead.

Wang Yan's expression changed. The worst outcome he originally thought was that Ye Fan would bring a senior executive from Shengbao Tower or Chen Ruotong's driver, so that he could be sure that Ye Fan had indeed joined Shengbao Tower, and he would find a way to ease the relationship with Ye Fan.

It's good now, Chen Ruotong is here in person!

"Ahem... Haha, I didn't expect that Mr. Chen Ruotong and Mr. Chen would come to our Polytechnic University reunion. It's an honor for us."

"What, Chen Ruotong!"

"It's actually her!"

Everyone was shocked. As engineering college students, of course they knew Chen Ruotong.

As a jewelry family, the Chen family has great influence. They often hold exhibitions and auctions overseas, with assets worth tens of billions. As the eldest daughter of the Chen family, Chen Ruotong was once on the list of outstanding entrepreneurs in the province. How could they not know?

"Haha, you're welcome, Mr. Wang. I'm here simply to accompany Master Ye Fan from Shengbao Tower. I apologize for any intrusion."

Chen Ruotong smiled, and everyone was shocked.

Came with Ye Fan?Master?

When did Ye Fan become so powerful!

Jiang Ling was stunned. She could not have imagined that Ye Fan, whom she despised, had actually become the appraiser of Shengbao Tower!

"Hehe...hehe, Mr. Chen is being polite."

Wang Yan laughed dryly and looked at Ye Fan, "Ye Fan, I knew you would have a future, and now it turns out that's the case. Come on, please take a seat."

As he spoke, he pulled out a chair himself.
